name: client-object-test-cc3f260977/remote-basic-v.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Supports remote-method-defn for client classes and resource-method-defn for service classes
Expressions: Client remote method call action; Method call; New expression; Field access expression; Range expression
Statements: Local variable declarations; If/else; Return; Foreach — Currently only supports range, list, map, string and XML subtypes, and iterable objects
Operators: Relational ops `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`; Additive ops `+`, `-`; Equality ops `==`, `!=`, `===`, `!==`
Object/class definitions: Only `client`, `service` and `isolated` object-type-quals / class-type-quals are supported
reason: All constructs and asserted behavior are supported: client-class construction, ordinary and remote positional calls, object fields and module variables, conditional returns, and range foreach with a local client object. The six output assertions follow the supported integer comparisons and fixed return values: false, true, 5, 10, 10, 10. The class qualifier restrictions admit client and unqualified classes.
test_design_notes: test3 and its global/field remote-call path are declared but not invoked by main.
No @args or @panic annotations; io:println only records the six asserted outputs.
